{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Chisa |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = This nickel-plated pair of scissors weighs about 152 grams. Its max opening angle is roughly 60 degrees. Just enough to cut through thick wool, even with quilted fleece hidden in the seam. I've always been able to estimate numbers like that, even as a little girl. But after that strange and terrifying power descended upon me, I started seeing more. Now, even a single inch feels like an entire world. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = When I was little, I'd sit on the porch of our house, listening to cicadas while cutting colored paper into goldfish and lucky stars. My mother would be nearby, stitching a yukata. The electric fan creaked as it turned, and slow midday dramas played on the TV... Now that I think about it, summers like that were kind of a luxury. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = In Honami, summer never ends. But there are no cicadas. No evening wind chimes. Only the endless loop of the Lament... Sometimes, I find old boxes of sugar candy in abandoned convenience stores. Normally, living beings shouldn't feel hunger inside a Sonoro Sphere. But that sugary taste always brings back memories of festivals back home, candy in hand... Sorry, I guess none of that really matters. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = I... I'm not good with faces. When I was little, people always said I got stuck on the details. But ever since faces started blurring in front of me, I've had to rely on that instead. In this Sonoro, "death" is only temporary. Those who disappear always show up again like nothing happened. So I take notes. The grease stain on the shopkeeper's sleeve across the road. The shape of the clerk's hair clip in the convenience store. That way, even if their faces are a blur, I still know who they are. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Since grade school, I was what people called a "straight-A student." Steady grades. Perfect attendance. Neat handwriting. Homework always early. Not a single crease in my textbooks. For most people, that's enough... and I don't mind that. People have always trusted me for those reasons, without ever really knowing me. But with you, it's different. You didn't come to me because you saw "I was performing well." You didn't stay because I seemed "reliable."
We've stood together on the edge of this city's collapse, again and again. That's why I wanted to say this. Like you said... we're partners. So of course I trust you, too. |vo_02_01_title = Chisa's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these. |vo_02_02_title = Chisa's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Chocolate bars... A former classmate gave me one once and said something like, "Keep frowning like that and your blood sugar's gonna crash." Didn't really get the science behind it. But after trying one... I started keeping a few boxes on hand. They're good for a quick energy boost, and they keep my head clear. That's the main reason I have them.
...But I do have to admit that chocolate is better than strawberry. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Spicy food. I tasted some {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}} cuisines while I was at the Black Shores, and they were... unique. It was the first time I was annoyed by my lack of tolerance for spice. But maybe this could change with enough practice? I'll have to try more. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = ...I don't have any grand ideals. I just know that if I see something happening, I can't pretend I didn't. If my abilities can help, even a little, then I'll keep using them. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = These small scissors I carry with me were a present from my mother. She used them her entire career as a seamstress. Later, I used them to alter my new school uniform I wore to orientation. It didn't quite fit, so I adjusted it myself. They feel like an invisible thread my parents stitched into me. Silent, yet always pulling me forward. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = The day they put this collar on me, it happened to rain in my hometown. I watched the downpour and rolling stormclouds through the window, and oddly enough, I felt a sense of relief. My Resonance Ability had been restrained. And I told myself, "Now they won't hate you anymore." |vo_04_01_title = About [[Sumika]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Sumika.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Sumika was the first to uncover the "loop pattern" of the {{Extra Effect|Sonoro|Sonoro Sphere|Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.}}. We used to pull all-nighters at the safe house, crunching data. I needed coffee to stay focused, but she always stayed sharp. Honestly, even borderline manic. But I knew how deeply she wanted to understand the truth behind the city's Lament. Maybe that's just the nature of a true researcher. Like she said, even the most dangerous equation still needs someone willing to solve it. |vo_04_01_mention = Sumika |vo_04_02_title = About [[Namipon]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Namipon.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it. |vo_04_02_mention = Namipon |vo_04_03_title = About [[Buling]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Buling.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = She's a very fascinating Taoist. If I remember correctly, she's from {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou|Mengzhou|One of the six major cities in Huanglong, renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Under the guidance of the local Sentinel, the Mengzhou people have developed unique Automata Mechanics.}}, in {{Extra Effect|Huanglong}}? She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a "Buy two, get 20% off" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see. |vo_04_03_mention = Buling |vo_04_04_title = About [[Shorekeeper]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Shorekeeper.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Shorekeeper helped me a lot while I've been recovering at {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}. It took me a while to settle in, but in time, I started to feel the kindness there. Shorekeeper once took me to the beach at the Haven of Sprouts to see the stars. They were infinite. And I found myself thinking... Sumika must've stood beneath that same sky many times, imagining the future she hoped to reach. |vo_04_04_mention = Shorekeeper |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = A birthday... isn't just the anniversary of your birth. It's also a reminder that you're still here. For me, that alone makes it important.
So... please continue to stay healthy, level-headed, endlessly capable, and someone others can count on. May each of your days pass smoothly, and may there always be someone walking alongside you.
—That's the most concise and practical birthday wish I could come up with. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Hmm… That's not it. It's this one. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort Sound) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = …Off you go then. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = I will… sever this deadlock. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = I'll cut to the chase. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Time to trim things down. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Let's work together again. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = ...The threads. I see them more clearly now. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Chisa |language = en |basic_1_tx = Clipped, down to the micron. |basic_2_tx = Excised, in a breath! |basic_3_tx = Dismantle! |basic_4_tx = To pieces! |basic_5_tx = Break apart! |basic_6_tx = Connections severed. |basic_7_tx = Cutting through the numbers! |basic_8_tx = Threads converge. |heavy_1_tx = Tether snapped! |heavy_2_tx = Deviation corrected. |resskill_1_tx = Dead center, locked. |resskill_2_tx = Eye of unraveling! |resskill_3_tx = Stress points mapped. |resskill_4_tx = This ends here! |resskill_5_tx = Structural collapse. |resliberation_1_tx = A pivotal moment. |resliberation_2_tx = Nothingness, deconstructed! |resliberation_3_tx = Come… meet your end. |introoutro_1_tx = Lifeline plucked. |introoutro_2_tx = Blink! |forte_1_tx = Break point, locked. |forte_2_tx = Fracture, marked. |hit_1_tx = ...The cut's not deep. |hit_2_tx = A miscalculation. |injured_1_tx = Structural integrity intact.
